message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: selling counterfeit goods (handbags) bearing a registered trademark (CELINE) without authorization. This is trademark infringement, counterfeit goods. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (counterfeiting trademark) or "假冒注册商标罪". The examples: earlier example with fake seal (买卖国家机关印章) gave answer "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". For counterfeit goods, we saw earlier example: "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物" for bomb. Not relevant. Another example: "走私珍贵动物、珍贵动物制品". Not relevant. For counterfeit goods, we need to see if any prior example includes counterfeit trademark. Not in given examples. But typical Chinese criminal law: Article 210 of Criminal Law: "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" includes manufacturing, selling, or importing counterfeit goods. So answer likely "侵犯注册商标专用权". Could also be "假冒注册商标罪". The phrasing: "销售明知是假冒注册商标的商品" matches "假冒注册商标罪". In Chinese law, "假冒注册商标罪" is under Article 210. So answer: [罪名]假冒注册商标罪<eoa>.
